faq.q: What does an AI product photo generator make?
faq.a: A listing image, a room scene, a detail, or a square ad from one clear photo or a short description. You review the file before you publish.

faq.q: How do I make the photo from one product picture?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or describe the scene, choose the style, then generate a square image. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: Is there a free AI product photo generator plan?
faq.a: No. Each image uses 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Are the photos usable on a product page?
faq.a: Yes, for listing, lifestyle, and ad images. Check each result against the product you ship so color, shape, and details still match.

faq.q: Can I make a white background and a room scene?
faq.a: Yes. A clean listing and a room scene are separate photos, and each one uses 24 credits. Check the product in both before you publish.

faq.q: Do these photos replace a studio shoot?
faq.a: They take the place of the studio booking for a new scene. You still compare the file with the product you ship, and you add prices in your own editor after download.

Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use on your store and ads, under our terms. That does not clear a source photo you do not own. The notes in [AI product photography](page:blog-ai-product-photography-guide) explain that check.

faq.q: Can I add a price or a logo on the photo?
faq.a: Add prices, offers, and logo text in your editor after download. Generated lettering can be wrong. [Shopify product photos](page:plat-shopify) shows one place those files can go.

faq.q: Where are the AI product photo templates?
faq.a: Browse [product ad templates](page:templates) for packshots, lifestyle scenes, and ad layouts. Then upload your product photo here and describe the scene.

faq.q: Can I run a batch or connect an API?
faq.a: Yes. A batch makes several scenes from the photos you upload, and the API can send those jobs from your catalog tool. Each photo still uses 24 credits, shown before it runs.

faq.q: Can I turn the photo into a video with a voiceover?
faq.a: Yes. Send the still into a product video, then add a voiceover, captions, or a track from the music library. A 6-second clip uses 24 credits, a 10-second clip 40, a 15-second clip 60, and a 30-second clip 120. [Image to video](page:image-to-video) is that next step.
